messages:
alex.k: kicking off partner activation for the new cloud marketplace listing + joint webinar. goal: first wave of demand-gen by EOW. quick sync? :wave:
maria.pmm: yes — can we lock webinar date first? prefer Tues/Thu mornings PST. 45 min with demo + customer panel.
sam.growth: Tue 10am PST works for me. I'll own the landing page + registration flow.
jess.prod: I can do the demo run + deck updates. need the benchmark narrative from product/eng to frame value props — latency/cost comparisons vs hosted alternatives.
alex.k: asked eng-runtime for benchmarks yesterday, but prod/eng said proto numbers will be ready by Wed AM. Maria, can you draft 2 headline messages: marketplace listing blurb and webinar hero copy? Keep one short technical variant and one business variant.
maria.pmm: on it. Drafts coming in an hour. For marketplace blurb I want: "Predictable, low-latency inference at scale — now in CloudMarket X". Will iterate.
sam.growth: routing notes — we should send all registrants to Marketo list "PMKT_PartnerCloud_2026" and annotate source=cloud_marketplace and utm_campaign=partner_activation_apr. Also need to wire inbound demo requests to sales SDR pool A.
nora.opsbot: Deployment note: created mailing list Marketo -> Redshift mapping. Job ID 7421. Next sync 2026-04-09 02:00 UTC.
jess.prod: quick Q: what are the lead scoring thresholds for auto-assign? Sam, can you paste the rule?
sam.growth: sure —

```
if (company_size > 200 && intent_score > 65) => assign SDR=A
else if (intent_score > 45 && role in ["eng","platform"]) => nurture by AE_B
else => marketing_nurture
```

this will be our baseline for the webinar cohort. we can tweak post-live.
maria.pmm: uploaded draft hero copy: https://drive.company/rdw/partner-hero-v1 — feedback welcome. Trying two hooks: "Serve production LLMs with predictable costs" and "Bring inference on-prem, in VPC, or hosted — same API."
alex.k: solid. Jess — please make sure demo script shows switching between Hosted/Dedicated/Private in <2 min. that will be our positioning sweet spot.
jess.prod: got it. Plan: 8 min demo, 10 min customer panel, 15 min q&a. Recording + CTAs at 1:10 mark.
sam.growth: creative — we should A/B test two CTA buttons on the landing page: "Start free trial" vs "Request a private demo". We'll split 50/50 by AB cookie.
maria.pmm: messaging iteration plan: run two email subject lines during registration funnel. Track open -> reg -> demo request. I'll post tracking sheet by EOD.
alex.k: logistics: partner will provide co-branded banner + short quote by Thurs 5pm PT. If we don't have it, we revert to single-brand creative.
nora.opsbot: Reminder: Legal approved co-marketing terms on 2026-04-01. Assets accepted: logos, one quote, 30-60s video clip.
jess.prod: runbook items for post-live: 1) capture webinar recording; 2) publish blog w/ bench narrative + transcript; 3) push repackaged clips to socials. assigning owners now.
sam.growth: assigning: blog draft - maria; social clips - sam; repackaged benchmarks - alex; follow-up nurture sequence - sam.
maria.pmm: ack. I'll wire up the blog outline to the SEO team. Need benchmark numbers asap to avoid rewrite.
alex.k: eng-runtime: pinged again for final numbers. If they miss Wed AM, we use conservative numbers + note 'typical reductions' vs baseline. don't inflate.
sam.growth: inbound routing snippet for ops team (paste into sales ops ticket):

```
source == "cloud_marketplace" OR utm_campaign == "partner_activation_apr" => list: PMKT_PartnerCloud_2026
if registrant.role in ["engineer","platform"] => tag: technical_lead
```

please ensure phone numbers are optional.
jess.prod: tiny design ask: can partner provide a transparent PNG logo? they sent an SVG but marketing system choked.
alex.k: noted. partner ops, pls resend. @maria.pmm can you escalate?
maria.pmm: emailing partner now. also adding an ask for a 1-2 sentence customer quote we can use in the blog and landing page.
nora.opsbot: Auto-reminder: Webinar draft calendar invite sent to participants. Event ID 98821.
jess.prod: final check — rehearsal scheduled Mon 10am PST. Please be there. we'll run deck + handoffs.
sam.growth: will be on. Also prepping a short benchmark one-pager for SDRs to use during follow-ups.
alex.k: great progress. next steps: Maria finalize copy, Sam finalize landing + routing, Jess finalize demo + rehearsal, Eng deliver numbers Wed AM, Partner assets by Thu 5pm PT. I'll follow up Fri for launch readiness. :rocket: 
maria.pmm: thanks team — will post updates in this thread. :raised_hands:
